paragraphs: Diarrhea can occur with capecitabine. Ongoing diarrhea can cause loss of fluid and body salts.
objects.title: Why it matters with this treatment

paragraphs: Diarrhea means loose, watery, or unformed bowel movements, or going more often than is usual for you. It may come with urgency, bloating, or cramps.
Other conditions can cause similar symptoms. Ariad cannot determine the cause.
objects.title: About this symptom

bullets: There are more than seven loose or watery bowel movements in 24 hours.
Diarrhea continues for more than 24 hours after medicine used according to your team's instructions.
You cannot drink enough, there is blood, or you have belly pain other than your usual cramping.
You notice thirst, dry mouth, dark or reduced urine, dizziness, vomiting, or a fast heartbeat.
objects.title: Contact your cancer team if…

bullets: Keep a record of bowel movements.
Unless your team has limited your fluids, sip fluids regularly.
Choose small meals and limit caffeine, alcohol, spicy foods, and high-fat foods.
Use anti-diarrheal medicine only as your cancer team instructed.
Keep the skin around the anus clean and dry, and use gentle care after bowel movements.
paragraphs: These are general measures. Follow any fluid, diet, or medicine instructions provided by your cancer team.

bullets: When the diarrhea began and the number of loose or watery bowel movements in 24 hours.
